title: Rename the chat:commands and chat:sessions IPC channels to <noun>:<verb>
notes: The chat:commands and chat:sessions channels (src/chat-sessions.ts, src/preload.ts) break the <noun>:<verb> rule in CLAUDE.md: the part after the colon is a noun, so each name reads as two nouns. Cost: every new channel copies them, as chat:models did in #87. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/88 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/87#discussion_r4419366661

comments.body: Done in PR #141 (tracked there as card 5a6ac86c): chat:commands and chat:sessions renamed to chat-commands:read and chat-sessions:read.
